items.title: 5.8 Steady, non-viscous aur ideal fluid (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.8 with Figs. 5.11 to 5.14 (PDF 104-106).

blocks.text: Chalte fluids bari ahmiyat rakhte hain. Harkat mein fluid ka rawayya jaanne ko hum pipes se us ka bahao dekhte hain. Jab fluid harkat mein ho to us ka bahao do tarah ho sakta hai, streamline ya turbulent.

blocks.title: Streamline flow
blocks.text: Bahao streamline ya laminar kaha jata hai agar kisi khaas nuqte se guzarne wala har zarra bilkul usi raste par chale jis par us nuqte se pehle guzarne wale zarre chale. Steady flow mein zarron ki harkat hamwar aur ba-qaida hai (Fig. 5.11); laminar flow mein fluid ke zarron ka hamwar rasta streamline hai. Streamline seedhi ya muri ho sakti hai, aur kisi bhi nuqte par us ki tangent fluid ke bahao ki simt deti hai; mukhtalif streamlines ek doosri ko kaat nahi saktin.

Pipe mein bahte fluid (Fig. 5.12) ki P par kuch velocity v1, Q par velocity v2, aur isi tarah hai. Agar P, Q aur R par zarre ki velocity waqt guzarne se na badle to bahao steady flow ya streamline flow hai. Zarre ke raste ko zahir karti lakeer PQR streamline hai: ba-tarteeb chalte zarron ka muqarrar rasta. Streamline flow mein P se guzarne wale sab zarre Q aur R se bhi guzarte hain, jis ka matlab hai ke do streamlines ek doosri ko kaat nahi saktin.

blocks.title: Turbulent flow
blocks.text: Fluid ka be-qaida ya ghair-mustaqil bahao turbulent flow kehlata hai. Ek khaas velocity se oopar harkat ghair-mustaqil aur be-qaida ho jati hai aur fluid ki velocity achanak badalti hai (Fig. 5.13); zarron ka theek rasta nahi liya ja sakta. Agar do streamlines ek doosri ko kaatein to zarre ek ya doosri simt mein jate hain aur bahao steady nahi: yeh turbulent hai, harkat mein bhanwar (eddies) aur gardab ke saath aur lagatar badalte raston ke saath.
Formula One racing cars ka streamlined design hai, aur dolphins ke jism pani mein harkat mein madad ko streamlined hain (For Your Information).

items: Fluid non-viscous hai: fluid ki mutasil tahon ke darmiyan koi raghrat ki force nahi.
Fluid incompressible hai: us ki density mustaqil hai.

blocks.title: Rate of flow
blocks.text: Pipe se fluid ke bahao ki raftar pipe ke kisi bhi section se fi unit waqt guzarne wala fluid ka volume hai.

Cross-sectional raqbe A ke pipe se waqt t tak velocity v se bahta fluid lein (Fig. 5.14); waqt t mein fluid ka tay kiya faasla l = v t hai, jahan l pipe ki woh lambai hai jo fluid waqt t mein guzarta hai. Waqt t mein pipe se guzarne wala volume A x l = A v t hai, to liquid ke bahao ki raftar = volume / waqt = A v t / t = A v: rate of flow = A v ... (5.14). SI units mein yeh cubic metre fi second (m^3 s^-1) mein napi jati hai, kabhi litre fi second (L s^-1) mein.

blocks.title: Steady flow
blocks.text: Agar bahao ka majmooi pattern waqt ke saath na badle to bahao steady flow kehlata hai. Steady flow mein fluid ka har zarra apne pichhle zarre jaisi flow line par chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Streamline aur turbulent flow mein farq karein (short question 5.2). 0.05 m diameter ke pipe se pani 2 m s^-1 se bahta hai; rate of flow kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Streamline: hamwar, ba-qaida, kisi nuqte se guzarta har zarra wahi rasta leta hai aur streamlines kabhi nahi kattin; turbulent: ek khaas speed se oopar ghair-mustaqil aur be-qaida, bhanwar aur katte raston ke saath. Rate = A v = 3.14 x (0.025)^2 x 2 = 3.9 x 10^-3 m^3 s^-1, taqreeban 3.9 L s^-1.

items: Streamline (laminar) flow: hamwar, ba-qaida, kisi nuqte se guzarne wale har zarre ka ek rasta; streamlines kabhi nahi kattin; un ki tangent simt deti hai. Turbulent: be-qaida, ghair-mustaqil, bhanwar, ek khaas speed se oopar. Ideal fluid: non-viscous, incompressible, steady.
Rate of flow = volume/waqt = A v (m^3 s^-1, L s^-1). Steady flow: pattern waqt ke saath nahi badalta.
